    // The closed polyline through `count` evenly spaced samples of a closed
    // curve. Precondition: count >= 3.
    ToClosedPolyline3D(self: IClosedCurve3D, count: Integer): Polyline3D
        => (self.SamplePeriodic(count), true);

    // `count` polar coordinates of a polar curve, evenly spaced over one full
    // turn with the duplicate seam omitted. Precondition: count >= 1.
    SamplePolar(self: IPolarCurve2D, count: Integer): Array<PolarCoordinate>
        => count.FractionsExclusive.Map(t => self.PolarPositionAt(t.Turns));

    // `count` positions on a parametric surface along one row of constant v,
    // u running over [0, 1] inclusive. Precondition: count >= 2.
    SampleRow(self: IParametricSurface, v: Number, count: Integer): Array<Point3D>
        => count.Fractions.Map(u => self.Eval(UvCoordinate(u, v)));

    // `count` positions on a parametric surface along one column of constant u,
    // v running over [0, 1] inclusive. Precondition: count >= 2.
    SampleColumn(self: IParametricSurface, u: Number, count: Integer): Array<Point3D>
        => count.Fractions.Map(v => self.Eval(UvCoordinate(u, v)));
}
